title: Beige: Your Dedicated Account Management Team
summary: This document explains Beige’s dedicated account management team: 2 assigned account managers coordinate onboarding, implementation, and ongoing optimization. It details support for implementation planning, treasury workflows (entitlements, reporting, automated movements), issue resolution to closure, and periodic reviews, plus best-practice engagement steps.
faqs: How many dedicated account managers will I be assigned and what do they coordinate?
What implementation support does Beige provide (milestones, success criteria, resources)?
What treasury workflows can the team configure (entitlements, reporting, automated movements)?
How does issue resolution work (triage, coordinating internal teams, remediation to closure)?
How often are reviews scheduled and what is their purpose?
What best practices should I follow when working with the team (single point of contact, treasury calendar, documenting change requests)?
